changeSummary: Reload animation shortened and ammo restock timing moved earlier
changeText: Reload animation duration decreased from 2.2s to 1.75s. Ammo now restocks at 1.1s instead of 1.3s during the reload animation.
devNote: Quality-of-life tuning intended to make Lockbolt feel smoother to use.

changeSummary: Cooldown reduced and item raise time removed
changeText: Cooldown decreased from 20s to 15s per charge. Item raise time decreased from 0.1s to 0s.
devNote: Embark wants Dematerializer to feel more responsive and return to a more viable Medium playstyle.

changeSummary: Cooldown decreased from 6.5s to 6s per charge
changeText: Cooldown decreased from 6.5s to 6s per charge.
devNote: A small reversal of the previous Dash restriction to restore some mobility without fully reverting earlier tuning.

changeSummary: Faster activation, more health, and shorter remote-retrieve cooldown
changeText: Activation time decreased from 3.5s to 3s. Health increased from 280 to 300. Remote-retrieve cooldown decreased from 17.5s to 10s; hand pickup remains 3s and destroyed-turret cooldown remains 35s.
devNote: Embark is nudging Guardian Turret upward for higher-skill viability while preserving its existing hand-pickup and destroyed cooldowns.
The AKM was slightly behind comparable Medium rifles such as the FAMAS and FCAR.

changeSummary: Fire rate increased and reload animations shortened
changeText: Fire rate increased from 725 RPM to 750 RPM. Quick reload animation decreased from 0.75s to 0.66s. Empty reload decreased from 2.73s to 2.7s.
devNote: The ARN-220 has trailed the XP-54 and M11, so this patch raises its close-range competitiveness and reload responsiveness.

changeSummary: Damage falloff multiplier increased from 0.65 to 0.7
changeText: Damage falloff multiplier increased from 0.65 to 0.7, increasing damage at range.
devNote: The BFR Titan was being outperformed at distances where Embark wants it to have a clearer Heavy-weapon niche.

changeSummary: Pellet damage increased from 8 to 9; full-shot damage increased from 104 to 117
changeText: Damage per pellet increased from 8 to 9, raising a full shot from 104 to 117 damage.
devNote: The Cerberus lost more combo power than intended when Quick Melee was reduced, so its shotgun damage was raised to compensate.

changeSummary: Primary and Backstab damage increased with longer lunge durations
changeText: Primary base damage increased from 42 to 49 and precise damage from 60 to 70; primary lunge duration increased from 0.15s to 0.22s. Backstab base damage increased from 75 to 85, backstab damage from 337 to 340, and secondary lunge duration from 0.22s to 0.32s.
devNote: Season 11 melee tuning continues, with higher damage and longer lunge windows intended to help Dagger connect more reliably while networking improvements are still in development.
statField: primary_damage / precise_damage / primary_lunge / backstab_base / backstab_damage / secondary_lunge

changeSummary: Precision zone angle increased from 9° to 12°
changeText: Primary precision zone angle increased from 9° to 12°, making precise strikes easier to land, especially on the second strike of the two-hit animation.
devNote: Embark widened the precision window because the second strike was too often landing as a normal hit instead of a precise hit.

changeSummary: Environmental damage and Deflect damage modifiers corrected
changeText: Fixed inconsistent primary environmental damage so attacks deal 25 environmental damage. Fixed wide-angle Deflect incorrectly blocking all damage; imprecise Deflect now uses a 20% damage modifier and precise Deflect uses 0%.

changeSummary: Range reduced with lower falloff multiplier and shorter falloff ranges
changeText: Damage falloff multiplier decreased from 0.675 to 0.58. Falloff start range decreased from 18m to 12m. Falloff end range decreased from 23m to 22m.
devNote: The KS-23 was competing too effectively at ranges where the BFR Titan is intended to be stronger.

changeSummary: Recoil and ADS dispersion increased to reduce effective range
changeText: Hip-fire recoil increased by approximately 75%, ADS recoil by approximately 25%, ADS bullet dispersion in most movement stances by 25%, and airborne ADS dispersion by 120%.
devNote: The M11 was outperforming its intended range and overlapping too much with the ARN-220 and XP-54.
newValue: +75% hip recoil / +25% ADS recoil / +25% ADS dispersion / +120% airborne ADS dispersion

changeText: Maximum-draw damage increased from 124 to 126. Base damage remains 60.
devNote: The increase restores some combo power lost when Quick Melee damage was reduced from 40 to 25.

changeSummary: Primary damage and Shield Bash damage increased; 5m lunge fix applied
changeText: Primary base damage increased from 58 to 60 and precise damage from 83 to 86. The intended primary lunge increase from 4.25m to 5m, previously listed in 11.3 but not working, is now fixed. Shield Bash damage increased from 40 to 50, environmental damage from 50 to 100, and Bash lunge duration from 0.5s to 0.6s.
devNote: The Riot Shield remains intended as a defensive, objective-anchoring weapon, but its elimination potential had fallen too far after the Season 11 rework.
statField: primary_base / primary_precise / primary_lunge / bash_damage / bash_environmental / bash_lunge_duration

changeSummary: Third-person impact visual and sound effects restored
changeText: Fixed an issue where Riot Shield impact visual and sound effects were missing from a third-person perspective.

changeSummary: Lunge reach, speed, sweep size, and Spin Attack sequence timing improved
changeText: Primary damage sweep box increased by 60%. Lunge distance increased from 5m to 6.5m, lunge duration from 0.3s to 0.45s, and lunge speed by 50%. Spin Attack reset delay increased from 0.2s to 0.35s so the sequence is easier to continue after hitting a target.
devNote: Embark is continuing to improve melee reliability while broader networking changes for lunge attacks are still being investigated.

changeSummary: Full-mag recoil curve fixed and airborne ADS dispersion reduced by 8%
changeText: Updated the recoil curve so it no longer jumps downward when an entire magazine is fired in one burst. Airborne ADS bullet dispersion decreased by 8%.
devNote: Quality-of-life tuning for two XP-54 edge cases that felt inconsistent.
